subject: Staff alignment: OKR gates & QBR readiness (week of Jul 1)
snippet: Weekly snapshot: wins, immediate risks (EU capacity + quantization regression), and asks — owners assigned and attachments included.
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Staff alignment: OKR gates & QBR readiness (week of Jul 1)

Team —

Quick weekly snapshot to align before QBR prep week. I tried to keep it tight: wins, acute risks, and discrete asks with proposed owners. Please add any missing owners inline.

WINS
- Serving performance: P95 generation latency down to ~120ms (measured on sampled host routes) — saved ~12% on token-costs via smarter prefix caching. (Owner: Jonas)
- Dedicated renewals: Nebula Analytics signed LOA for dedicated cluster; migration window scheduled for Aug 2–6. (Owner: Maya / CS)
- Observability: new token-level cost chart is live in Console beta (internal).

RISKS 
- Model quantization experiments (vq-2) show a small but consistent drop in reranking quality on internal evals (0.8–1.5% score delta). If this persists we risk upstream regression in search features — requires triage this week. (Probable owner: Research / Applied ML)
- EU capacity: forecasting indicates possible shortfall in EU pool during expected August burst from Nebula migration. Need capacity plan + fallback policies. (Owner: Karthik)
- Procurement: Nebula requested a 10% service credit tied to a specific SLA clause for the migration delay; finance needs an official position. (Owner: Finance / Laura)
- SOC2 evidence: Missing artifact for data-retention policy in the compliance bundle; Security requests a 48‑hour turnaround. (Owner: Maya)

ASKS (clear, short):
1) Exec sign-off on a 3-day infra freeze for July 6–8 to stabilize the release candidate before QBR demos. (Decision: APPROVE / DECLINE) — proposed approver: Laura.
2) Approve conditional 10% credit offer to Nebula subject to migration playbook (Doc + sign-off). Immediate ask for Finance to review. (Owner: Laura)
3) Assign a lead to triage the quantization regression (data, failing prompts, rollback criteria) and report back with a runbook by Friday EOD. (Proposed owner: Jonas + Research)
4) Confirm EU burst capacity plan: either add 2x nodes to EU pool for August or commit to cross-region fallback with 200ms extra latency. We need cost estimate and risk acceptance. (Owner: Karthik)

Attachments: okr_gates_tracker.csv, QBR_prep_slide_deck_v2.pptx — slide deck contains my suggested QBR narrative + two appendix slides for the Nebula ask.

If you can call out owners inline, I will compile an action list and publish to the Exec channel.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Staff alignment: OKR gates & QBR readiness (week of Jul 1)

Aditya — thanks for the concise rundown. A few quick items: 

- Good on the latency win — can you add a one-line regional breakdown (US vs EU) in the tracker? I want that for the QBR 'operational levers' slide.
- For the Nebula credit ask, please loop in CFO (cc'ed) and include the customer-impact rationale + estimated MRR exposure if we decline. Finance will want the DocuSign path and an alternate small-credit option (e.g., service credit tied to SLA milestones).
- Quantization regression: Jonas, please flag the top 10 failing prompts and a minimal rollback plan. If the rollback requires a model swap we need to know deployment blast radius.
- SOC2 artifact: Maya, please confirm ETA. Security will expect the evidence in the compliance bundle by Fri 16:00 UTC.

I approve the proposed 3-day infra freeze pending that we publish a short outage/maintenance notice to customers by EOD tomorrow. Who owns the communication? (Suggest: Communications / Product Marketing — assign and I will sign off.)

Laura Bennett
COO, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, claire@nebulaanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Staff alignment: OKR gates & QBR readiness (week of Jul 1)

Laura / Aditya — quick update from infra & research POV below; attaching a one‑page draft (nebula_mop_draft.docx) that lays out migration constraints and proposed credit structure.

- Quantization triage: Initial analysis shows drift on reranker signals related to tokenization edge-cases with the compressed weights (vq-2). I will
  - surface top 12 failing prompts by 17:00 today (Jonas)
  - propose a targeted re-quant schedule for a subset of models (non-prod first) — rollbacks feasible via model-variant routing; expected rollback risk small but needs testing.
- EU capacity: Karthik and I ran a quick forecast — adding 3x r6-nodes for August burst keeps P95 within SLO. Cost to customer is non-applicable; cost to us ~ $32K/month for the window (estimate). Two alternatives: short-term burst (preferred) or cross-region fallback with a 160–220ms penalty.
- Communications: I can prepare the maintenance notice draft by 15:00 and coordinate with Product Marketing.

I copy Claire from Nebula to confirm they are comfortable with the proposed migration window (Aug 2–6) and to surface any additional constraints from their side.

Attachment: nebula_mop_draft.docx (migration ops playbook — owner: Jonas)

Jonas Weber
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — capturing next steps and owners below, will publish the Exec action list and push the deck to the shared Drive.

Action register (owners & deadlines):
- Quantization triage: Jonas & Research — deliver top-12 failing prompts + rollback plan by Fri 17:00 UTC.
- EU capacity: Karthik — costed plan for 3x nodes or cross-region fallback by Fri 12:00 UTC.
- Nebula credit + migration playbook: Jonas (ops) + Maya (CS) + Laura (Finance sign-off) — submit DocuSign-ready credit worksheet by Mon EOD; DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/nebula-credit-approval
- SOC2 artifact upload: Maya — compliance bundle update by Fri 16:00 UTC.
- Maintenance notice: Jonas + Product Marketing — draft by Thu 15:00 (Jonas will circulate).

I will prepare the QBR narrative using the deck appendix and include a one-slide 'decision ask' that lists the Nebula credit options for approval during the Friday leadership call. If we can get Finance agreement before the call it makes the decision faster.

Closing note: tagging Claire (claire@nebulaanalytics.com) — please confirm migration constraints and whether Nebula can accept the proposed blackout window.

—
Aditya Rao
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
